proposals.weakness_identified: Flat ₹20/order brokerage + slippage (-1.68% fee drag) turns +0.34% gross edge negative (-0.94% net).
proposals.hypothesis: Filtering ORB entries to strong-trend days with >= 0.8% target distance improves net expectancy.
proposals.expected_benefit: Higher win rate and lower fee-to-profit ratio.
proposals.falsification_criterion: Reject if Unseen Test net return <= baseline ORB or < 5 unseen trades.

proposals.weakness_identified: Over-trading (168+ trades) causes -11.25% to -20% cumulative fee drag on ₹50,000 capital.
proposals.hypothesis: Requiring 1.2% target hurdle + EMA9>EMA21 alignment cuts low-expectancy whipsaws.
proposals.expected_benefit: Reduce trade count by >50% and improve net return on Validation & Unseen splits.
proposals.falsification_criterion: Reject if Unseen Test net return does not beat v1.0 baseline.

proposals.weakness_identified: EMA crossovers whipsaw during SIDEWAYS_LOW_VOLATILITY regimes.
proposals.hypothesis: Abstaining (Cash/No-Trade) when ADX/trend breadth is weak preserves capital.
proposals.proposed_change: Restrict entries to 09:30-14:00 IST with VWAP & EMA alignment.
proposals.expected_benefit: Lower max drawdown and higher Sharpe ratio.
proposals.falsification_criterion: Reject if net return fails to turn positive after costs on Unseen Test.
